description:
Background: bd:JMAP-wlip.8 closed the bench-visibility half — Dispatcher::dispatch now has dispatch_single_call and dispatch_batch_of_sixteen benches so the per-call spawn overhead is measurable in criterion. The actual perf optimization is an architectural decision.

Current shape (crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs:177): each method call inside a batch is run via tokio::task::spawn(async move { handler.call(...).await }).await. The JoinHandle is awaited immediately, so only one call runs at a time. The spawn exists purely for panic isolation — a panicking handler returns serverFail instead of crashing the connection task.

Proposed shape: std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe + FutureExt::catch_unwind from futures-util. Catches panic without spawn — saves the per-call allocation and scheduler hop. Tested against the existing panicking_handler_returns_server_fail and panic_message_not_in_response tests.

Cost:
- Adds futures-util dep to jmap-server. AGENTS.md restricts to 'serde, serde_json, tokio, http, thiserror' — explicit dep allowlist change.
- Behavioural change: tokio::task::JoinError's is_cancelled() / is_panic() distinction goes away. Today lib.rs:218-223 uses is_cancelled() to emit 'task cancelled' vs 'internal error' in the serverFail description. With catch_unwind, the cancellation case (future-drop while a handler is mid-execution — which today's task::spawn handles by running to completion anyway, since the JoinHandle drop doesn't cancel the spawned task) collapses into the panic-only path.
- Tests that match on the descriptions ("task cancelled" vs "internal error") would need updating.

Benefit:
- ~200ns + alloc overhead per call saved. At 10k req/sec with 4 calls each, ~8ms CPU/sec.
- Smaller flame-graph footprint at high request volume.

Bead author's confidence: low ("low for non-hot-path consumers; meaningful for a high-throughput proxy or multi-tenant Mailbox server").

Decision needed from Mark:
- (a) Schedule for a future minor that adds futures-util to the allowlist.
- (b) Defer indefinitely; the bench is in place to surface the cost when it matters.
- (c) Reshape now.

Pairs with bd:JMAP-wlip.34 (cancellation): both touch the spawn-vs-catch_unwind axis; deciding on one affects the other.
title: Architectural decision: replace task::spawn with catch_unwind for panic isolation in Dispatcher
